DESCRIPTION: Unique AGEB key: state (2) + municipality (3) + locality (4) + AGEB (4).
DERIVATION: Urban: 13-character CVEGEO. Rural: CVE_ENT + CVE_MUN + '0000' + CVE_AGEB.
NOTES: Always read as text: it has leading zeros and CVE_AGEB is alphanumeric. See D-03.

DESCRIPTION: Setting of the AGEB, according to the Marco Geoestadístico layer it comes from.
DERIVATION: 'Urbana' if it comes from {ENT}a.shp; 'Rural' if it comes from {ENT}ar.shp.
NOTES: Values: Urbana (urban), Rural. Population sources differ by setting (D-11).

DESCRIPTION: State (entidad federativa) code.
State name.
NOTES: Without accents (e.g. 'Ciudad de Mexico', 'Nuevo Leon').

DESCRIPTION: Municipality or territorial demarcation code (3 digits, unique only within the state).
NOTES: The full municipal code is CVE_ENT + CVE_MUN.

DESCRIPTION: Municipality name.
Locality code (4 digits). '0000' by convention in rural AGEB.
DERIVATION: Rural: '0000' (a rural AGEB does not belong to a single locality).
NOTES: See D-03.

DESCRIPTION: Locality name.
DERIVATION: Urban: locality name in the MG. Rural: ITER name if the AGEB has a single locality; '(varias localidades)' (several localities) if it has more.
NOTES: The NOM_LOC of the urban census is unusable: it always reads 'Total AGEB urbana' (D-06).

DESCRIPTION: AGEB code (4 alphanumeric characters).
Area of the AGEB.
DERIVATION: Polygon area in EPSG:6372 (LCC ITRF2008) after st_make_valid().
NOTES: National minimum 0.0003 km²; rural AGEB can exceed 6,000 km².

DESCRIPTION: Longitude of a representative point inside the AGEB.
DERIVATION: st_point_on_surface() in EPSG:6372, transformed to EPSG:4326.
NOTES: Not the geometric centroid: it is guaranteed to fall inside the polygon (D-07).

DESCRIPTION: Latitude of a representative point inside the AGEB.
Total usually resident population.
DERIVATION: Urban: AGEB total row. Rural: sum of POBTOT over the ITER localities that fall in the AGEB.
NOTES: Never suppressed by INEGI. The national sum matches the Census exactly: 126,014,024 (D-12).

DESCRIPTION: Population whose characteristics the census does publish.
DERIVATION: Urban: POB_TOTAL, or 0 if the whole AGEB row is suppressed. Rural: sum of POBTOT over the localities that publish all characteristics.
NOTES: See D-14.

DESCRIPTION: Share of the AGEB population whose characteristics the census publishes.
NOTES: Use it as a reliability weight or filter for the shares, especially in rural areas.

DESCRIPTION: Number of census cells in the AGEB imputed as 1.5 because they were suppressed ('*').
DERIVATION: Count of '*' cells among the 52 counts in CENSUS_VARS, only in urban rows not wholly suppressed.
NOTES: Always 0 in rural AGEB (ITER does publish 1 and 2). Nationally: 253,460 cells in 55,573 urban AGEB (D-15).

DESCRIPTION: Male population.
DERIVATION: Urban: direct value. Rural: sum over localities that publish the SEXO group.
NOTES: Can be 1.5 in urban AGEB (imputation).

DESCRIPTION: Female population.
Share of men.
UNIVERSE: Population of the localities that publish the SEXO group (= POB_TOTAL in urban)

DESCRIPTION: Share of women.
Population density.
NOTES: In rural AGEB it divides by the whole territory, not by the inhabited area.

DESCRIPTION: Persons per inhabited private dwelling.
NOTES: Uses total population, not occupants. In tiny AGEB with imputed dwellings it yields extreme values (52 AGEB > 10; max 679): filter by size.

DESCRIPTION: Total inhabited private dwellings.
DERIVATION: Urban: direct. Rural: sum over localities that publish the VIV group.
NOTES: Includes dwellings with no occupant information, which is why it is NOT the denominator of housing shares (D-18). In 781 urban AGEB with population 0 it is 1.5 through imputation; no share is affected.

DESCRIPTION: Inhabited private dwellings whose characteristics were captured (estimate). Denominator of every housing share.
DERIVATION: min(VIV_PART_HAB, max(VPH_C_ELEC+VPH_S_ELEC, VPH_DRENAJ+VPH_NODREN, VPH_EXCSA+VPH_LETR, and each individual VPH_* count)).
NOTES: The census does not publish this universe (CONEVAL does use it). It is the largest of its lower bounds, capped by TVIVPARHAB. See D-18.

DESCRIPTION: Dwellings with drainage (public sewer, septic tank, ravine, river, lake or sea).
Dwellings with electricity.
Share of dwellings with drainage.
NOTES: Its denominator changed (formerly TVIVPARHAB). For the deprivation use PCT_VIV_SIN_DRENAJE, which is not 100 − this value (D-19).

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with electricity.
NOTES: Same as PCT_DRENAJE; for the deprivation use PCT_VIV_SIN_ELECTRIC.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 0 to 5.
UNIVERSE: Population of the localities that publish the PERS group
NOTES: Heat, waterborne disease and dependence during evacuation.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 65 and over.
NOTES: Heat mortality, reduced mobility.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population with a disability.
NOTES: Disability = much difficulty with, or inability to, see, hear, walk, remember, care for oneself or communicate.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 3 and over who speak an indigenous language.
NOTES: Proxy of structural marginalization. For the language barrier to warnings, PCT_POB_HLI_NHE is better.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 3 and over who speak an indigenous language and do not speak Spanish.
NOTES: Direct barrier to receiving official warnings and alerts. National median 0 %: highly concentrated.

DESCRIPTION: Share of census households whose reference person is a woman.
NOTES: Common in the social vulnerability literature, but its direction is debatable; decide when building the index.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population without health service affiliation.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_SSALUD.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 15 and over who are illiterate.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_ANALF.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 15 and over with incomplete basic education.
DERIVATION: min(100, 100 × (no schooling + incomplete primary + complete primary + incomplete lower secondary) / POB_15YMAS).
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_EBINC. Capped at 100 because it adds four possibly imputed cells (D-20).

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 6 to 14 not attending school.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_INA614.

DESCRIPTION: Share of population aged 15 to 24 not attending school.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_INA1524. It is a difference: it includes those who did not specify attendance. National median 56 %: weakly discriminating for vulnerability.

DESCRIPTION: Labour force participation rate: share of the population aged 12 and over with a specified activity status who are economically active.
UNIVERSE: Population aged 12 and over with a specified activity status (PEA + PE_INAC)
NOTES: Does not divide by P_12YMAS: the unspecified share is 0.2–0.5 % per state but reaches 27 % in some AGEB. Summed from Oaxaca's AGEB it gives 57.03 %, equal to the ITER state total. The census does not capture income; this is the closest economic signal.

DESCRIPTION: Female labour force participation rate: share of women aged 12 and over with a specified activity status who are economically active.
UNIVERSE: Women aged 12 and over with a specified activity status
NOTES: Discriminates more than PCT_PEA across AGEB (Oaxaca: 34 % rural against 48 % urban). Correlates with PCT_HOG_JEFA and with educational lag; check collinearity when building the index.

DESCRIPTION: Unemployment rate: share of the economically active population with no job who looked for one.
NOTES: Weakly discriminating: informal work counts as employment and the census rate is low (1.7–2.3 % per state). In urban AGEB the count is often 1–2 and imputed as 1.5 (D-15), so in small AGEB it is noise.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings without drainage.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_SDREN. Direct count, not 100 − PCT_DRENAJE (D-19).

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings without electricity.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_SELEC.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings without piped water inside the dwelling or its plot.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_SAGUA. Water stress and drought.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a dirt floor.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_PISOT. Proxy of housing precariousness in the face of flooding.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a single room.
NOTES: Overcrowding and indoor heat.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with no toilet, sanitary facility or latrine.
NOTES: Equivalent of RZ_SEXCUS. The only complement: no direct count exists. As in CONEVAL, a latrine counts as a sanitary facility (D-19).

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a rooftop water tank (tinaco).
NOTES: Water storage against supply cuts and drought.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a cistern.
Share of dwellings with a refrigerator.
NOTES: RZ_SREFRI = 100 − this value (CONEVAL publishes the deprivation).

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a washing machine.
NOTES: RZ_SLAVAD = 100 − this value.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a car or pickup truck.
NOTES: Evacuation capacity.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a radio.
NOTES: Early-warning channel that does not depend on the power grid or on data networks.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a landline telephone.
NOTES: RZ_STELF = 100 − this value.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a mobile phone.
NOTES: RZ_SCEL = 100 − this value.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with internet.
NOTES: RZ_SINTER = 100 − this value.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with a computer, laptop or tablet.
NOTES: RZ_SCOMPU = 100 − this value.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with neither radio nor television.
Share of dwellings with neither landline nor mobile phone.
Share of dwellings with no information and communication technology at all.
NOTES: No radio, TV, computer, landline, mobile phone, internet, pay TV, streaming or games console. Highly correlated with PCT_VIV_SIN_BIENES.

DESCRIPTION: Share of dwellings with no goods at all.
NOTES: No refrigerator, washing machine, microwave, vehicle, bicycle or any ICT.

DESCRIPTION: Average years of schooling of the population aged 15 and over.
DERIVATION: ESC_ANIOS_TOT / POB_15YMAS, where ESC_ANIOS_TOT = Σ GRAPROES × P_15YMAS of each locality (rural) or of the AGEB (urban).
NOTES: Averages are not summed: they are turned into totals and divided again (D-17). INEGI excludes those who did not specify their grade; here the denominator includes them, a minor difference.

DESCRIPTION: Average occupants per room in inhabited private dwellings.
DERIVATION: OCUP_CON_CUARTOS / CUARTOS_TOT, with CUARTOS_TOT = Σ OCUPVIVPAR / PRO_OCUP_C (only where PRO_OCUP_C > 0).
NOTES: Stand-in for RZ_HACIN (the census does not publish the count of overcrowded dwellings). Not validated against CONEVAL because one is an average and the other a share.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL's Social Lag Grade (Grado de Rezago Social) of the urban AGEB.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Values: Muy bajo, Bajo, Medio, Alto, Muy alto (very low to very high). There is no continuous index (IRS) per AGEB (D-23).

DESCRIPTION: Social Lag Grade, numerically coded.
DERIVATION: 1 = Muy bajo (very low), 2 = Bajo, 3 = Medio, 4 = Alto, 5 = Muy alto (very high).
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Ordinal: do not average it as if it were continuous.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of population aged 15 or over who are illiterate.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Census equivalent: PCT_ANALF.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of population aged 6 to 14 not attending school.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_NOASIS_6A14.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of population aged 15 to 24 not attending school.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_NOASIS_15A24.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of population aged 15 or over with incomplete basic education.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_EDU_BAS_INC.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of population without health service entitlement.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_POB_SIN_SALUD.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of overcrowded dwellings.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: No exact equivalent; PRO_OCUP_C is the closest stand-in.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without piped water from the public network.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_VIV_SIN_AGUA.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without a toilet or sanitary facility.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_VIV_SIN_SANITARIO.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without drainage.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_VIV_SIN_DRENAJE.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without electricity.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_VIV_SIN_ELECTRIC.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings with a dirt floor.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: PCT_VIV_PISO_TIERRA.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without a washing machine.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: 100 − PCT_VIV_LAVADORA.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without a refrigerator.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: 100 − PCT_VIV_REFRI.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without a landline telephone.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: 100 − PCT_VIV_TELEFONO.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without a mobile phone.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: 100 − PCT_VIV_CELULAR.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without a computer, laptop or tablet.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: 100 − PCT_VIV_COMPU.

DESCRIPTION: CONEVAL: % of dwellings without internet.
NA_MEANING: E: rural; S: not published by CONEVAL
NOTES: Equivalent: 100 − PCT_VIV_INTERNET.

DESCRIPTION: Economic units registered in DENUE.
DERIVATION: Count of records whose AGEB key resolves to this AGEB.
NOTES: Includes every SCIAN sector. DENUE is from 2026-05, not 2020 (D-26).

DESCRIPTION: Manufacturing economic units.
Trade economic units.
NOTES: Proxy of access to supplies.

DESCRIPTION: Service economic units.
DERIVATION: Count with SCIAN sector between 48 and 81.
NOTES: Includes DEN_EDU: the counts are not additive.

DESCRIPTION: Educational service economic units.
NOTES: Subset of DEN_SERV. Identical to SCHOOL_TOT across the country.

DESCRIPTION: Units of legislative, governmental and judicial activities.
NOTES: Proxy of institutional presence.

DESCRIPTION: Schools (proxy of potential temporary shelters).
NOTES: Currently identical to DEN_EDU (sector 61 only has subsector 611). They are not official shelters.

DESCRIPTION: Area of water bodies inside the AGEB.
DERIVATION: Area of the intersection AGEB ∩ union of water bodies, in EPSG:6372.
NOTES: Areal intersection, never a spatial join (D-27).

DESCRIPTION: Share of the AGEB area covered by water bodies.
NOTES: Does not measure flood hazard: only the presence of mapped surface water.

DESCRIPTION: Flag for the presence of water bodies in the AGEB.
Land use and vegetation class covering the largest area of the AGEB.
DERIVATION: Class with the largest dissolved area inside the AGEB.
NA_MEANING: C: no USV polygon intersects the AGEB
NOTES: 129 classes nationally; 'ASENTAMIENTOS HUMANOS' (human settlements) is the most frequent. Scale 1:250,000: little detail in small urban AGEB.

DESCRIPTION: Share of the AGEB covered by the dominant class.
Share of the AGEB classified as human settlement or urban area.
DERIVATION: min(100, Σ CLASS_PCT of classes containing ASENTAMIENTO, ZONA URBANA or URBANO).
NOTES: Coarse proxy of built-up surface (heat island), limited by the 1:250,000 scale.

DESCRIPTION: Distance to the nearest operating hospital (second or third level of care), public or private.
DERIVATION: Euclidean distance in EPSG:6372 to the nearest hospital in the country. Urban and uninhabited rural: from the AGEB interior point. Inhabited rural: mean over its inhabited localities weighted by POBTOT (see DIST_ORIGEN).
UNIVERSE: Operating CLUES units of type DE HOSPITALIZACIÓN (inpatient), excluding psychiatric and addiction hospitals, geocoded within 5 km of their state
NOTES: Straight-line distance, not travel time: it understates access problems in mountain areas. Includes 3,645 private hospitals, many of them small clinics; for people without social security use DIST_HOSP_PUB_KM.

DESCRIPTION: Distance to the nearest operating public hospital (second or third level of care).
SOURCE_VARIABLE: LATITUD, LONGITUD, NOMBRE DE LA INSTITUCION
DERIVATION: Same as DIST_HOSP_KM, restricted to public institutions.
UNIVERSE: Hospitals of DIST_HOSP_KM except private medical services and Red Cross
NOTES: Straight-line distance, not travel time: it understates access problems in mountain areas. Always ≥ DIST_HOSP_KM (check health_public_hospital_not_nearer).

DESCRIPTION: Distance to the nearest operating public first-level care unit (health centre, family medicine unit, rural medical unit).
DERIVATION: Same as DIST_HOSP_KM, with first-level outpatient units.
UNIVERSE: Operating CLUES units, DE CONSULTA EXTERNA (outpatient) and PRIMER NIVEL (first level), public, fixed (no mobile units or brigades), excluding prosecutors, forensic services, CIJ, SCT and DIF
NOTES: Straight-line distance, not travel time: it understates access problems in mountain areas. Almost always short (median < 1 km in urban AGEB); it discriminates mostly among rural AGEB.

DESCRIPTION: Point from which distances to health facilities, streams and the coast were measured.
DERIVATION: 'Localidades' if the AGEB is rural and has inhabited localities in {ENT}lpr.shp; otherwise 'Punto interior'.
NOTES: Values: Localidades (localities), Punto interior (interior point). Every urban AGEB uses the interior point; a rural one with Punto interior is uninhabited. For relief (ELEV_M, slopes) the same rule uses the whole polygon instead of the interior point, and 150 m discs instead of the locality points.

DESCRIPTION: Mean elevation of the inhabited ground above mean sea level.
DERIVATION: Mean of the CEM 4.0 cells (15 m). Urban and uninhabited rural: over the whole polygon. Inhabited rural: 150 m disc (TERRAIN_BUFFER_M) around each inhabited locality, mean weighted by POBTOT.
UNIVERSE: CEM cells inside the polygon or the discs
NA_MEANING: C: islands the CEM does not cover
NOTES: Referenced to the Mexican Gravimetric Geoid 2010. Can be slightly negative on coastal plains. Together with DIST_COSTA_KM it identifies low-lying coastal areas.

DESCRIPTION: Mean slope of the inhabited ground.
DERIVATION: terra::terrain(slope, degrees) over CEM 4.0; mean per zone. Urban and uninhabited rural: over the whole polygon. Inhabited rural: 150 m disc (TERRAIN_BUFFER_M) around each inhabited locality, mean weighted by POBTOT.
NA_MEANING: C: islands the CEM does not cover
NOTES: CEM 4.0 is radar-derived (ALOS PALSAR): in dense cities it partly follows rooftops, so urban slope reads somewhat rough.

DESCRIPTION: Share of the inhabited ground with slope above 15 degrees.
DERIVATION: 100 × share of cells with slope > 15°. Urban and uninhabited rural: over the whole polygon. Inhabited rural: 150 m disc (TERRAIN_BUFFER_M) around each inhabited locality, mean weighted by POBTOT.
NA_MEANING: C: islands the CEM does not cover
NOTES: 15° is a common threshold for moderate susceptibility to mass movement.

DESCRIPTION: Share of the inhabited ground with slope above 30 degrees.
DERIVATION: 100 × share of cells with slope > 30°. Urban and uninhabited rural: over the whole polygon. Inhabited rural: 150 m disc (TERRAIN_BUFFER_M) around each inhabited locality, mean weighted by POBTOT.
NA_MEANING: C: islands the CEM does not cover
NOTES: Always ≤ PCT_PEND_15 (check terrain_slope_consistent). Median 0: highly concentrated in the mountains.

DESCRIPTION: Straight-line distance to the nearest stream of Strahler order 3 or higher.
DERIVATION: Distance in EPSG:6372 to the nearest segment of the hydrographic network with ORDER_1 ≥ 3 (STREAM_MIN_ORDER). From the interior point (urban and uninhabited rural) or from each inhabited locality, weighted by POBTOT (see DIST_ORIGEN).
UNIVERSE: Flow lines (streams and centre lines) of order ≥ 3, perennial or intermittent
NOTES: At 1:50,000 almost any point lies a few hundred metres from a first-order gully; the order filter keeps streams with an appreciable catchment. Use it together with DESNIVEL_CAUCE_M: close and only slightly above is what signals risk.

DESCRIPTION: Height of the inhabited ground above the nearest water: the bed of the order ≥ 3 stream or the sea, whichever is closer.
DERIVATION: ELEV_M of the origin (disc or polygon) minus the elevation of the nearest water: the lowest CEM cell within 45 m (STREAM_BED_RADIUS_M) of the closest point on the stream, or 0 if the coast is closer. Weighted by POBTOT in rural AGEB.
NA_MEANING: C: the stream bed falls outside the CEM
NOTES: Approximation of HAND (height above nearest drainage) using the stream nearest in plan, not the one on the actual flow path: it can be negative if that stream runs in the next valley. It does not account for levees, channel capacity or rainfall.

DESCRIPTION: Straight-line distance to the coastline.
DERIVATION: Distance in EPSG:6372 to the nearest coastline segment, excluding the Frontera (land border) segments. Same origins as DIST_CAUCE_KM.
NOTES: Coastal lagoons count only where the CONABIO layer draws them as coast. For storm surge, combine with ELEV_M (e.g. < 10 m).

DESCRIPTION: Flood hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30). Nationally almost uniform across the five classes (492–496 municipalities each).

DESCRIPTION: Drought hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30). Heavily skewed: only 9 municipalities are Muy alto and 1,082 are Bajo.

DESCRIPTION: Heat-wave hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30). It is the heat hazard available at this scale; it does not replace an intra-urban heat-island indicator.

DESCRIPTION: Tropical cyclone hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30).

DESCRIPTION: Landslide susceptibility grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30). Terrain susceptibility, not a hazard with a return period. 1,692 of 2,469 municipalities are Alto, so on its own it discriminates little.

DESCRIPTION: Thunderstorm hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30).

DESCRIPTION: Hail hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30).

DESCRIPTION: Low-temperature hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30).

DESCRIPTION: Snowfall hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30). 2,318 of 2,469 municipalities are Muy bajo: informative only in the north and in high mountain areas.

DESCRIPTION: Seismic hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30). Not a climate hazard; included for multi-hazard analysis. The Muy bajo class is used in no municipality.

DESCRIPTION: Volcanic hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5. 'Sin peligro' = 0.
NA_MEANING: C: only if the municipality has no row in the CENAPRED table
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard. It stays out of the vulnerability index (D-30). The only column where 0 = 'Sin Peligro' (1,138 municipalities), a real absence of hazard, not missing data. Not a climate hazard.

DESCRIPTION: Toxic-substance hazard grade of the municipality the AGEB belongs to.
DERIVATION: CENAPRED label recoded: Muy bajo=1, Bajo=2, Medio=3, Alto=4, Muy alto=5. 'Sin peligro' = 0.
NA_MEANING: C: 12 recently created municipalities (02006, 04012, 07120–07125, 17034–17036, 23011) carry a blank field in the source
NOTES: Municipal resolution: every AGEB in the municipality shares the value. It is an ordinal class, not a physical magnitude, and its scale is not comparable with another hazard.
